cohort: The study sample consisted of 410 women with infants aged 0-12 months living in Turkiye.
finding: A significant negative correlation was identified between maternal depression and breastfeeding self-efficacy, suggesting that maternal depression negatively impacts the desire to breastfeed and breastfeeding success.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between April 24 and May 10, 2022, from women with infants aged 0-12 months.
